decks.notes: The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Eye of Ugin, Eldrazi Temple, and Lotus Petal, allowing players to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher ahead of schedule. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland to disrupt opponents' strategies, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive Eldrazi creatures while controlling the game with disruptive elements. The deck's focus on quick mana acceleration and powerful creatures creates a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle that aims to dominate opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with key creatures and then using reanimation spells to bring them back into play, bypassing their high mana costs. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck can generate card advantage with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also presenting threats like Murktide Regent, Archon of Cruelty, and Brazen Borrower. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing control over the game by using aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Magus of the Moon to disrupt opponent's strategies. The key strategy involves utilizing fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to cast powerful spells like The One Ring and Sundering Eruption. The deck also capitalizes on locking opponent's lands with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void for further disruption. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and secure victory.

The key concept of this deck revolves around using cheap and efficient spells to control the game early on, while deploying threats that pressure the opponent quickly. By combining disruptive spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce with efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence. The mana denial provided by Wasteland, along with card selection from Ponder and Brainstorm, helps to keep the pressure on the opponent and maintain a tempo advantage throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing cards that prevent them from casting spells effectively. By utilizing cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere, the deck aims to lock the opponent out of their resources while deploying threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Fury to end the game quickly. The combination of powerful red spells and aggressive creatures makes this Dragon Stompy deck a formidable force in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on playing powerful Eldrazi creatures quickly, using mana acceleration from cards like Ancient Tomb and Grim Monolith. Chalice of the Void disrupts opponents' game plans while Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin help cast threats ahead of schedule. Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher provide disruptive threats, while Glaring Fleshraker and Wastescape Battlemage offer additional aggression. Wasteland and Wastes disrupt opponents' mana bases, and Cavern of Souls ensures that our Eldrazi spells can't be countered. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures while disrupting their plans.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using Mystic Forge and various artifacts like Basalt Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Grim Monolith. By using the artifacts to generate mana and manipulate the top of the library, the deck aims to consistently cast powerful spells and creatures such as Ugin, Karn, and Kozilek's Command. With support cards like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt opponents, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage, mana acceleration, and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play using cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. The goal is to cheat out creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. With a mix of control elements and explosive reanimation plays, this deck aims to win the game in the early turns before the opponent has a chance to respond.

The primary focus of this Bant Control deck is to establish board control through a variety of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as counter spells such as Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and control the board with powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Carpet of Flowers and Back to Basics to disrupt opponents' mana bases and ensure that the control aspects of the deck are maximized.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's game plan with a mix of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and counter spells like Force of Will. It also uses powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Kolaghan's Command to control the board. Additionally, the deck includes card advantage engines like Snapcaster Mage, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, and Thundertrap Trainer to outvalue the opponent. The deck's win condition is to grind the opponent out with efficient removal and card advantage, ultimately overwhelming them with threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Orcish Bowmasters.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Entomb. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to control the game and protect its combo pieces. By utilizing powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through a combination of fast, aggressive plays and resource denial with cards like Daze and Wasteland.

The deck relies on using multiple fast mana sources and card draw spells to generate a large amount of mana quickly, cast multiple spells in a single turn, and eventually win the game through a storm combo. By generating a high storm count, the deck can finish off the opponent with cards like Tendrils of Agony. The deck also has access to various tutor effects and wish cards to search for key combo pieces or answers as needed. The deck utilizes a mix of black and green mana sources along with artifact acceleration to power out its combo pieces efficiently.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Ancient Tomb, Eldrazi Temple, and Grim Monolith to get out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer as quickly as possible. Chalice of the Void and Cavern of Souls provide disruption and protection for your creatures, while cards like Kozilek's Command and Glaring Fleshraker help control the board and push damage through. The deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent with its aggressive Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady tempo with aggressive plays. The key strategy involves utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the board and protect key threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. The deck also leverages efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters to deal with opposing threats. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and helps dig for key cards, while the mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility. Overall, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents through a mix of disruption and aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to maintain tempo and card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, while also utilizing land disruption with Wasteland. The combination of disruptive spells, efficient threats, and card selection allows the deck to quickly close out games through aggressive plays and incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using fast mana like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors to cast powerful threats like Magus of the Moon and Blood Moon to disrupt opponents' mana bases. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Fury to pressure opponents and finish the game quickly. The One Ring provides additional value and versatility, while cards like Sundering Eruption and Shatterskull Smashing provide removal and reach to close out games. The strategy is to lock down opponents while applying pressure to win the game before they can recover.
